verdict.rationale: Fin's first-party materials describe an AI-powered Insights layer that continuously analyzes every Fin and human conversation. It is paired with AI Recommendations, AI Topics, Trends, Monitors, CX Score and Custom AI Scorecards, which together deliver AI-generated insights and suggestions from the customer's own support data inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights and recommendations are generated and acted on (the evidence is marketing and pricing-level only), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights are useful.
